correctness.rationale: Exact spectral eigenvectors and the \(2\times2\) hub block reconstruct amplitude (1), independently checked against graph matrix exponentials for nine graph orders. The irrational case follows from 2-torus density plus an exact first-order vector projection and localization to four base-phase peaks; no numerical recurrence is substituted for the supremum. In the square case, a cosine-gap identity and global maximizer comparison force \(O(D^{-1})\) neighborhoods and justify the uniform z-limit; the residue-class phase computation and strictly positive second derivative identify unique constants. All quantifiers concern \(m\to\infty\) within three stated subsequences, all t≥0; finite computations are supporting checks only.

value.rationale: The ordinary friendship graph is a natural one-parameter quantum communication topology with near-perfect sibling transfer as the network size grows. Unlike a routine parameter substitution into spectral formulas, the sharp optimized infidelity admits three discontinuous leading coefficients selected by rationality and triangular-number residue classes. It quantitatively refines a known O(m^-1) join bound and supplies a meaningful boundary for peak transport performance despite no claim about finite-time readout delays.
